title: PR Merge
description: Merge an approved PR after checks pass.
template:
PR-MERGE TASK.

Workspace: {{workspace}}.
Pipeline step: {{pipeline_step}}.
Previous results: {{previous_results}}.

Merge an approved PR after checks pass. This step owns that merge: `git merge` (including `--squash`) onto the PR base branch is expected once CI is green and the PR is approved. Never force-push or rewrite already-published history.

Write the RESULT artifact (JSON matching result.schema.json) to a file named RESULT at the workspace root. The verdict field MUST be one of: PASS,FAIL. Include a one-sentence summary.
